name: Fitness Resort kara no Dasshutsu
original_name: フィットネスリゾートからの脱出
source:
Iori and his twin stepsisters Rio and Eri had an... intimate relationship.
One summer they rented a room at a beach fitness resort.
In the name of training, but for the sake of vacation, their stay was comped
by the hotel owner in exchange for participating in a hotel-wide reality game:
their challenge was to "escape" the hotel. It seemed like fun!
But what they really looked forward to... 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ160254.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Iori与双胞胎继姐妹Rio、Eri之间，有着……亲密的关系。
某年夏天，他们在海边的健身度假酒店租了一间房。
名义上是去锻炼，其实是为了度假。酒店老板免去了住宿费，
条件是他们要参加一场覆盖全酒店的实景游戏，
挑战内容，就是从酒店里“逃脱”。听起来很好玩！
可他们真正期待的是……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ160254.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
